welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.body: Let's take a quick look around the home page so you can get started.

stats.title: Streak, XP and Gems
stats.body: Study every day to keep your 🔥 streak. Finish exercises to earn XP and Gems — use them to level up and buy items.

courses.title: Your courses
courses.body: These are the courses you can study. Contact an admin to unlock advanced content.

review.title: Review
review.body: Go over questions you got wrong and words you saved, scheduled with spaced repetition.

pet.title: Pets
pet.body: Look after your pet and play mini games to review vocabulary. Your pet also helps explain questions.

nav.title: Navigation bar
nav.body: Jump between home, leaderboard, profile and more from here.

tip.title: Tip: quick word lookup
tip.body: Double-click any English word to see its meaning and save it for review.
